{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the premises
print("Status values and counts:")
print(df['status'].value_counts(dropna=False))

print("\nRevenue data type:")
print(df['revenue'].dtype)

print("\nFirst few revenue values:")
print(df['revenue'].head())

# Check for sentinel values in revenue
print("\nNumber of rows with revenue = 999999.99:")
print((df['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum())

# Check for -1 in customer_age
print("\nNumber of rows with customer_age = -1:")
print((df['customer_age'] == -1).sum())"}
